title: Named non-setting state and schema version targets
cluster_summary: Three per-repo naming gaps with no shared root cause and no upstream fix. LootHistory's schema.md says holdings has one writer ('Reconciler:Flush only'), which is false: ForgetHolder (the Forget popup) and MarkLoginGenesis (LoginScan) also write it, so that sentence should be fixed. KickCD's migration target is named CURRENT_DB_VERSION instead of the standard's NS.SCHEMA_VERSION. The value is correct, so this is an optional consistency rename, best done if KickCD is already being edited. PanelMaster is refuted: the Settings Schema section spills to docs/schema.md as documentation-§3 sanctions, and schema.md already gives minimapPos its key, owner (core/LauncherSetup.lua) and writer and act (LibDBIcon, on drag).

verdicts.assessment: docs/schema.md:388 says 'holdings: Reconciler:Flush only', but Reconciler.ForgetHolder -> Holdings:ForgetHolder (Forget popup, settings/Slash.lua:45) and R.MarkLoginGenesis -> Holdings:MarkGenesis (LoginScan, after Flush) also write it. architecture-§5 treats an omitted writer as a doc-only MUST failure. The fix is one clause, and the current line is false, not just incomplete.
verdicts.remediation: Rewrite the Writers bullet in docs/schema.md: 'holdings: Reconciler:Flush (the diff pass); Reconciler:ForgetHolder -> Holdings:ForgetHolder (the Forget popup, KA0S_LOOTHISTORY_FORGET_HOLDER); R.MarkLoginGenesis -> Holdings:MarkGenesis (the login scan).' No register row.

verdicts.assessment: ARCHITECTURE.md ## Settings Schema summarizes and spills into docs/schema.md, which documentation-§3 sanctions. Settings Schema already mentions LibDBIcon's minimap table, and schema.md:22 and :38-42 name global.minimap.minimapPos, its owner core/LauncherSetup.lua and its writer LibDBIcon on button drag. The claim that it appears 'only in the launcher table' is false.

savedvariables-§1 requires the runner target in NS.SCHEMA_VERSION. KickCD uses a local CURRENT_DB_VERSION = 5 republished as Database.CURRENT_DB_VERSION, and no Documented deviations row covers it. The value is correct and no player can reach it, so the only gain is collection-wide naming consistency, since the other ten addons use NS.SCHEMA_VERSION. Do it if KickCD is already being edited in this run.
verdicts.remediation: Publish NS.SCHEMA_VERSION = 5 in core/Database.lua. Repoint the runner (core/Database_Migrations.lua:18, :376, :382) and modules/Diagnostics.lua:103-104, and drop the Database.CURRENT_DB_VERSION alias. Update the comments (core/Database.lua:78; Database_Migrations.lua:12, :32, :339, :368, :381), the docs (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:405, docs/module-map.md:51, docs/schema.md:13) and the tests (tests/test_database.lua, tests/test_diagnostics.lua:145-147, tests/test_color_shape.lua:271). Optionally add a test pinning NS.SCHEMA_VERSION to the highest step's to. Regenerate test-cases.md and the badge if the test count changes. Leave frozen docs/audits, docs/reviews and superpowers bundles untouched.
